description: This file declares functions and constants for generating and validating PUCCH (Physical Uplink Control Channel) resources in a 5G NR scheduler, including resource list generation, parameter validation, and UE-specific configuration building.

methods.name: pucch_parameters_validator
methods.description: Validates user-defined parameters for building the cell PUCCH resource list, returning an error message if invalid.

methods.name: generate_cell_pucch_res_list
methods.description: Generates a list of cell PUCCH resources (Format 0/1 and 2/3/4) based on input parameters, spreading resources across the BWP.

methods.name: ue_pucch_config_builder
methods.description: Builds the PUCCH configuration for a UE, generating resource lists for HARQ-ACK, SR, and CSI, and updating the serving cell config.
